results.title: Luxembourg Institute of Science and Technology
results.description:
The Biodiversity Monitoring and Assessment (BIODIV) group brings together researchers, engineers, and technicians to advance how biodiversity data are collected, analysed, and interpreted. Acting as a national hub at the science–policy interface in Luxembourg, the group generates and analyses data on a wide range of organisms to assess their conservation status and dynamics.

Through close collaboration with national stakeholders and European partners, the BIODIV group coordinates large-scale monitoring programmes, with a focus on:

- Tracking the conservation status of protected species under EU directives (e.g. Water Framework Directive, Habitats Directive)
- Assessing ecosystem health through the monitoring of key taxonomic groups (e.g. wild pollinators, forest mammals, freshwater invertebrates, diatoms)
- Detecting and documenting the spread of invasive alien species
- Developing innovative technologies for biodiversity data collection, processing and analysis

results.title: Geological and Environmental Management Services
results.description: GEMS is an environmental and biodiversity consultancy organization working on biodiversity assessment, ecosystem management, environmental research, and GIS-based biodiversity information management. Its work includes the collection, analysis, documentation, and dissemination of biodiversity data, particularly in Pakistan. GEMS aims to contribute reliable biodiversity occurrence, ecological, and spatial datasets to support research, conservation planning, environmental assessment, and evidence-based biodiversity management.
